summary: Fresh full-branch backend and QA reviews found two issue-#28 blockers: redundant Source identity composition can conflict with signed per-request headers, and post-deletion events may be classified contract_invalid before the local deletion tombstone yields workspace_deleted. All other loop-3 blocker groups and system cleanup/diagnostic behavior reviewed cleanly.
validation: Backend reviewer inspected the complete origin/main...407110f diff and reran validate-specs plus 19 focused Knowledge tests
QA lead inspected all REQ-001..REQ-008 mappings and reran 16 resolver tests plus 15 system lifecycle/diagnostic tests
Both reviewers confirmed the real-flow test launches separate Source, Workspace, Model, and Knowledge processes
QA review confirmed replay/build identity and the repaired system cleanup, timeout, diagnostic, and leak boundaries
git status and origin/main...HEAD diff checks were clean at reviewed HEAD 407110f
blockers: Knowledge Worker configures a default X-Workload-Identity while WorkloadProof also supplies the signed per-request value; remove the redundant default and cover configured composition.
Snapshot ingestion resolves dependencies before checking the local deletion tombstone, so Workspace status=deleting can reach contract_invalid DLQ instead of the typed workspace_deleted outcome.
next_action: Return to code for minimal composition and deletion-classification fixes with focused regression tests, then repeat full-branch review at a new clean HEAD.

issues.title: Source workload identity is redundantly composed
issues.details: KnowledgeService.Worker Program.cs adds X-Workload-Identity as a default header while WorkloadProof.Apply adds the signed request header. Remove the default and add a worker composition test proving one configured signed identity.

issues.title: Deleting workspace can be classified as contract_invalid
issues.details: IngestSnapshotAsync resolves Source/Workspace/Model before the local tombstone check. A Workspace status=deleting response throws ContractValidationException and reaches contract_invalid DLQ rather than KnowledgeWorkspaceDeletedException/workspace_deleted.
